+TEST_F(JsonTest, JsonComparisons) {
+  if (in_prod_env()) {
+    GTEST_SKIP() << "JSON comparison not supported in production Spanner yet";
+  }
+
+  GOOGLESQL_EXPECT_OK(Insert("JsonTable", {"id", "col"},
+                   {1, cloud::spanner::Json("{\"a\": 1}")}));
+  GOOGLESQL_EXPECT_OK(Insert("JsonTable", {"id", "col"},
+                   {2, cloud::spanner::Json("{\"b\": 2}")}));
+  GOOGLESQL_EXPECT_OK(
+      Insert("JsonTable", {"id", "col"}, {3, cloud::spanner::Json("null")}));
+  GOOGLESQL_EXPECT_OK(Insert("JsonTable", {"id"}, {4}));
+
+  // Equality
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT id FROM JsonTable WHERE col = JSON '{\"a\": 1}'"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRow({1}));
+
+  // Inequality
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT id FROM JsonTable WHERE col != JSON '{\"a\": 1}' "
+                    "ORDER BY id"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRows({{2}, {3}}));
+
+  // Less than
+  EXPECT_THAT(
+      Query(
+          "SELECT id FROM JsonTable WHERE col < JSON '{\"b\": 2}' ORDER BY id"),
+      IsOkAndHoldsRows({{1}, {3}}));
+
+  // Less than or equal to
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT id FROM JsonTable WHERE col <= JSON '{\"b\": 2}' "
+                    "ORDER BY id"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRows({{1}, {2}, {3}}));
+
+  // Greater than
+  EXPECT_THAT(
+      Query(
+          "SELECT id FROM JsonTable WHERE col > JSON '{\"a\": 1}' ORDER BY id"),
+      IsOkAndHoldsRows({{2}}));
+
+  // Greater than or equal to
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT id FROM JsonTable WHERE col >= JSON '{\"b\": 2}' "
+                    "ORDER BY id"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRows({{2}}));
+
+  // Ordering / Min Max
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT MIN(col) FROM JsonTable"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRow({cloud::spanner::Json("null")}));
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT MAX(col) FROM JsonTable"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRow({cloud::spanner::Json("{\"b\":2}")}));
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT id FROM JsonTable ORDER BY col"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRows({{4}, {3}, {1}, {2}}));
+
+  // Group by
+  EXPECT_THAT(
+      Query("SELECT col, count(*) FROM JsonTable GROUP BY col ORDER BY col"),
+      IsOkAndHoldsRows(
+          {{cloud::spanner::MakeNullValue<cloud::spanner::Json>(), 1},
+           {cloud::spanner::Json("null"), 1},
+           {cloud::spanner::Json("{\"a\":1}"), 1},
+           {cloud::spanner::Json("{\"b\":2}"), 1}}));
+
+  // Join
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT t1.id FROM JsonTable t1 JOIN JsonTable t2 ON "
+                    "t1.col = t2.col WHERE t1.id = 1"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRow({1}));
+
+  // Cast
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT CAST('{\"c\": 3}' AS JSON)"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRow({cloud::spanner::Json("\"{\\\"c\\\": 3}\"")}));
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT JSON '{\"c\": 3}' = '{\"c\": 3}'"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRow({false}));
+
+  // Comparison with non-json (e.g., int)
+  EXPECT_THAT(Query("SELECT id FROM JsonTable WHERE col = 3"),
+              IsOkAndHoldsRows({}));
+}

+TEST_F(QueryTransformerTest, CorrelatedSubqueryWithHavingAggregate) {
+  const std::vector<std::string> queries = {
+      // Correlated Var in SELECT list, HAVING with aggregate on local Var.
+      "SELECT count(*) FROM keyvalue v WHERE EXISTS "
+      "(SELECT v.key FROM \"KeyValue2\" u HAVING count(u.key) > 1)",
+      // Correlated Var in SELECT list, GROUP BY and HAVING aggregate on local
+      // Var with same (varno, varattno).
+      "SELECT count(*) FROM keyvalue v WHERE EXISTS "
+      "(SELECT v.key FROM \"KeyValue2\" u GROUP BY u.key "
+      "HAVING count(u.key) > 1)",
+      // Correlated Var in SELECT list, GROUP BY and HAVING non-aggregate on
+      // local Var with same (varno, varattno).
+      "SELECT count(*) FROM keyvalue v WHERE EXISTS "
+      "(SELECT v.key FROM \"KeyValue2\" u GROUP BY u.key HAVING u.key > 1)",
+      // Correlated Var in SELECT list, ORDER BY aggregate on local Var.
+      "SELECT count(*) FROM keyvalue v WHERE EXISTS "
+      "(SELECT v.key FROM \"KeyValue2\" u ORDER BY count(u.key))",
+      // Correlated Var in SELECT list, GROUP BY and ORDER BY local Var.
+      "SELECT count(*) FROM keyvalue v WHERE EXISTS "
+      "(SELECT v.key FROM \"KeyValue2\" u GROUP BY u.key ORDER BY u.key)",
+      // Multi-level correlated Var (varlevelsup == 2) in SELECT list with
+      // HAVING aggregate on local Var.
+      "SELECT count(*) FROM keyvalue v WHERE EXISTS "
+      "(SELECT 1 FROM \"KeyValue2\" w WHERE EXISTS "
+      "(SELECT v.key FROM keyvalue u HAVING count(u.key) > 1))",
+  };
+
+  for (const std::string& sql : queries) {
+    GOOGLESQL_ASSERT_OK_AND_ASSIGN(
+        std::unique_ptr<const ResolvedStatement> transformed_statement,
+        ForwardTransformQuery(sql, analyzer_options_));
+    googlesql::Validator validator(analyzer_options_.language());
+    GOOGLESQL_ASSERT_OK(validator.ValidateResolvedStatement(transformed_statement.get()))
+        << "Failed for SQL: " << sql;
+  }
